up: Retrieve distinct target TID and preferred name pairs for activities with exact Ki values. The target must be a single protein target. Activities must have a Ki value with no standard relation or units filter, but exact numeric values are required. Include all such activities regardless of source or target family. Return each unique target TID and preferred name pair only once.
sql:
WITH exact_ki AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_chembl_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE a.standard_type IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_type = 'Ki'
    AND a.standard_relation IS NULL
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_units IS NULL
  GROUP BY a.molecule_chembl_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT td.tid, td.pref_name
FROM exact_ki ek
JOIN activities a ON ek.molecule_chembl_id = a.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE a.standard_type = 'Ki'
  AND a.standard_relation IS NULL
  AND a.standard_units IS NULL
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND td.target_type = 'PROTEIN';

up: Retrieve distinct target TID and preferred name pairs for activities where the activity type is Ki (inhibition constant) and the Ki value is provided exactly (i.e., standard_relation and standard_units are NULL) with a non‑null standard_value. No other filters are applied; include any assay type or target family. Return each unique target TID and preferred name pair exactly once.
sql:
WITH exact_ki AS (
  SELECT a.molregno,
         a.standard_value AS ki_value,
         a.standard_units,
         a.standard_relation
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE a.standard_type = 'Ki'
    AND a.standard_relation IS NULL
    AND a.standard_units IS NULL
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND td.target_type = 'PROTEIN'
  GROUP BY a.molregno
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT td.tid,
                td.pref_name
FROM exact_ki ek
JOIN activities a2 ON ek.molregno = a2.molregno
JOIN assays ass2 ON a2.assay_id = ass2.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass2.tid = td.tid
WHERE a2.standard_type = 'Ki'
  AND a2.standard_relation IS NULL
  AND a2.standard_units IS NULL
  AND a2.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
